description: Context-specific resolutions for KMP tile indices outside the stored KCG payload. These affect editor rendering only; source KMP words and KCG bytes remain unchanged.

MAP27_A.KMP.evidence: The sole 0x03FF word is at (2,30) in the otherwise tile-0 border. Tile 1023 is the maximum 10-bit tile value and is used as a blank fill marker by PW_BG01; the regular renderer itself does not special-case it.

PW_BG01.KMP.evidence: Scene setup 08066780 clears 0x06000000..0x0600FFFF before 08066870 loads 235 tiles at 0x06000000. Tile 1023 remains zero-filled.

PW_BOX.KMP.evidence: The five cells are transparent in PW_BOX.KCG.png. Its 13,632-byte KCG ends at tile 426, while scene setup clears VRAM before loading it at 0x06004000, leaving the referenced tail zero-filled.
